newsitem.title: UK: Copper spreads stay firm by LME close.
newsitem.headline: Copper spreads stay firm by LME close.

text.p: COPPER - Closes slightly lower, but attention on firm spread premiums. Cash/one day at $24, cash/one week at $100. Cash/threes backwardation indicated at steep $330/340. Spreads to stay tight.
ALUMINIUM - Moves away from $1,625, still closes down.
NICKEL - Cuts losses by close. TIN - Ends weak under $5,900
LEAD - Ends sharply lower. ZINC - Finishes softer. ALLOY - Stable.
